references.text: Matthew 14:13 tells of Jesus' flight across the sea to a desolate place after the death sentence on John, a parallel event with the same travel pattern.
Mark 6:32 uses almost identical wording about Jesus' journey across the sea to a desolate place and shares the geographical description of the Sea of Galilee.
Luke 5:1 describes Jesus by the Lake of Gennesaret (Sea of Galilee) and uses the same geographical setting as the basis for a new event.
